title: Intercepted? Jets notch first INT in 364 days during preseason game vs. Steelers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Intercepted? Jets notch first INT in 364 days during preseason game vs. Steelers
sources.description: The Jets haven't intercepted anything, especially a football, in a long time. That drought finally came to an end in Week 2 of the preseason.
